name: Playtest
description: Goldfish your deck: deal opening hands (with the free mulligan of multiplayer Commander), keep or mulligan, play turns – draw, play cards, tap them, life and poison counters – and see the odds of having the cards you need by a given turn. Plays your own cards as MSE draws them, real cards with their real pictures, or any decklist (Decklists → Playtest). Until MSE Studio 0.25 this page came with the app.
author: MEZTKING
